description.en: Plays a tactics scene with the given characters. It lets the field camera run (clears OFF_RPG_CAMERA from the pause bits), sets system flag 6 (IFLAG_END_AUTO_FADEIN_OFF) to 1, requests the scene with CMND_SETUP_RUN_TAC(_tacID, _aAtk, _aDef, 0, _mapID) and suspends while it plays. It then clears the flag and restores the pause bits.
Handles of the moving participants (at most 11).
Handles of the other participants; [0] for none.

examples.case: Four characters for a tactics scene (real usage, from ev42011800.nut)
